A potential association between tirzepatide and hypercalcemia in the setting of chronic hydrochlorothiazide use. Hypercalcemia is a prevalent electrolyte disturbance commonly associated with primary hyperparathyroidism, cancer, or medication adverse effects. Thiazide diuretics reduce urinary calcium excretion, increasing calcium reabsorption and hypercalcemia.
